title: Page 177
transc:
HE Thayer  Washn Sept 16th 1864
To Col A J Perry
Qr Mr P period You
will take possession of the
books & papers of W
B N Cozzens W Neal
and Pugh the tent maker
arrested for frauds upon the 
Govt and Col H S
Olcott wilby allowed freely to
examine these books & papers
By order of the Secy
of War C A Dana


Cipher Clerk  Washn Sept 16th 1864 
Nashville
Grapes Gas Nancy for Pandora Donaldson Chf Vinton
who can relieve Paradise Crane as disbursing officer
sugar The duties of Inspector and of disburse
sing officer are incompatible Having been appointed Inspector
he must be relieved of his present duties
MC Meigs


John A long pembroke dispatch is
coming through from Jolly to you
shall it be for warded to
you at Baptism or wait your
arrival here webster Brutus ans quick
